calc_hub_no_profile: Each tool works from a profile, and you have none yet.

scope_view_deg_invalid: Enter an angle above -90° and below 90°
scope_view_wind_dir_from: Where the wind comes from: 0° = from the target, 90° = from the right
scope_view_wind_hint_no_wind: No wind felt on the face
scope_view_wind_hint_light_wind: Wind felt on the face, environment is calm

scope_view_no_valid_result: Cannot compute — check profile and conditions
scope_view_result_hold_title: At {distance} {unit}, no time to dial? Hold.
scope_view_atmo_isa_note: Good when you don't know the weather.
scope_view_pressure_qnh_hint: QNH is the sea-level pressure from weather reports; the app corrects it for your altitude.
scope_view_pressure_station_hint: Station is what a Kestrel or your phone barometer reads on site. It is used as entered.
scope_view_current_weather_note: Optional. On tap, asks for your location and sends it, rounded to about 1 km, to Open-Meteo. Fills altitude, pressure, temperature and humidity once; you can edit them after.
scope_view_current_weather_done: Filled from current weather at {time}. Check the values before you shoot.
scope_view_current_weather_error_denied: Location access is off. Allow it in your browser or phone settings, or enter the values by hand.
scope_view_current_weather_error_unavail: Your location could not be found in time. Try again outdoors, or enter the values by hand.
scope_view_current_weather_error_network: The weather service could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
scope_view_current_weather_error_invalid: The weather service gave no usable values. Nothing was changed.
about_description: ZRO is a precision ballistic calculator for long-range shooting sports. It computes bullet trajectories, generates dope cards, and provides a scope reticle view for field use.
about_open_source_desc: ZRO is open source software, released under the MIT License. View the source code and contribute on GitHub.
about_js_ballistics_desc: Ballistic calculations are powered by the js-ballistics open-source library.
about_bclibc_desc: js-ballistics runs the bclibc solver engine 2.0.0 as a WebAssembly module. bclibc is free software under the GNU Lesser General Public License, version 3, and comes with no warranty. ZRO ships it unmodified. Its source code is available on GitHub.
licenses_intro: ZRO is released under the MIT License. It includes third-party software under its own licence. The texts below are also shipped with the app, in the licenses folder.
licenses_lgpl_title: GNU Lesser General Public License, version 3
privacy_no_data_desc: The app sends nothing you enter anywhere. There is no account, no analytics and no tracking. All calculations run on your device. The only exception is the optional current weather, below.
privacy_storage_desc: The app keeps these in the local storage of the browser or app, on this device only:
privacy_storage_profiles: Your profiles, and which one is active
privacy_storage_inputs: The values last entered in the ballistic calculator, scope view, trajectory validation, compare trajectories and MPBR
privacy_storage_dark_mode: Your dark mode choice, once you change it
privacy_storage_language: Your language choice, once you pick one
privacy_storage_keep: They stay until you clear the site data in your browser or uninstall the app. They are not encrypted, not synced and not backed up. The app sets no cookies. A language cookie set by earlier versions is deleted when the app starts.
privacy_weather_desc: In the Accurate mode of the atmosphere, on the Scope View and the Ballistic Calculator, "Use current weather here" asks for your location only when you tap it. It then sends your latitude and longitude, rounded to about 1 km, to Open-Meteo (open-meteo.com), and nothing else: no profile and no other value. Open-Meteo also sees your IP address and which site or app made the request, like any server. In Switzerland and around it, Open-Meteo gives the values of the MeteoSwiss ICON-CH1 model; elsewhere, its default models. The answer fills altitude, pressure, temperature and humidity, which are stored like values you type. Your location is not stored. If you never tap it, nothing is sent. It needs a connection, and the desktop app does not offer it.
privacy_web_desc: On the web, the server that hosts the app receives each request for its files, like any web server. It sees your IP address, the files requested and your browser type. What the host logs, and for how long, is not known to the app. The desktop and mobile apps load their files from the device.
privacy_offline_desc: The desktop and mobile apps contain all their files and work offline. The web version needs a connection to load. It has no offline mode, and charts and dope cards load extra code when you open them, so they may not load without a connection.
privacy_store_desc: Basic usage statistics may be collected by the app store platform (Google Play Store, Apple App Store) as part of their standard analytics.
validation_range_above_zero: Enter a number above 0 and up to {max} {unit}
validation_range_below_max: Enter a number from {min} to under {max} {unit}
error_page_message: The page you are looking for does not exist.
ballistic_step_min: Enter a step of at least {min} {unit}
ballistic_step_max: Enter a step of at most {max} {unit}, the max distance
ballistic_altitude_too_low: The altitude is too low for this shot: the calculation stops when the bullet goes below {min} {unit}.
ballistic_pressure_hint: As given in weather reports. The app corrects it for the altitude above.
ballistic_air_too_thin: This air is too thin and humid to calculate. Check the pressure, temperature and humidity.
ballistic_no_profile: No active profile. Go to Profiles to activate one.
ballistic_no_result: Cannot compute — check profile and conditions.
ballistic_intro: Drop, wind and speed for every distance. Change a condition and the chart and table follow.
ballistic_stat_near_zero_note: Bullet first crosses the line of sight
ballistic_stat_far_zero_note: Bullet crosses the line of sight again
ballistic_stat_subsonic_note: Below the speed of sound from here
ballistic_stat_supersonic_note: Stays supersonic to the max distance
ballistic_table_highlight: The highlighted row is the Scope View target distance.
mpbr_target_size_hint: Vital zone diameter — bullet must stay within this zone
mpbr_hint: Enter target size and click Calculate
mpbr_no_profile: No active profile. Go to Profiles to activate one.
mpbr_no_result: Cannot compute MPBR — check profile data and target size.
mpbr_about_definition: Maximum Point Blank Range is the farthest distance at which you can aim dead-center and still hit a target of a given size — no hold-over, no dialing.
mpbr_about_zero: Zero at the Optimal Zero distance. The bullet arcs up to the top of the target zone, then falls back through it at the far end.
mpbr_about_beyond: Beyond the MPBR maximum, the bullet drops below the target zone. You must hold over or dial elevation to compensate.
mpbr_about_ideal: Ideal for red dots and iron sights where quick shots leave no time for elevation adjustments.
mpbr_zero_out_of_range: This zero is past {max}, the longest zero the other calculators take, so it cannot be saved to the profile.
traj_val_range_hint: Distance at which you observed the bullet impact
traj_val_measure_hint_angle: Dial-up correction observed at range (bullet below line of sight)
traj_val_measure_hint_angle_above: Dial-down correction observed at range (bullet above line of sight)
traj_val_measure_hint_distance_above: Bullet height above line of sight measured at range
traj_val_above_los_notice: With this profile the bullet is above the line of sight at this range. If you measured it above, choose Above.
traj_val_no_profile: No active profile. Go to Profiles to activate one.
traj_val_hint: Enter an observation to validate the trajectory
traj_val_no_result: No solution: this observation cannot be reached with the current profile. Check the observed value, the above/below choice, and the profile's zero distance and optic height.
traj_val_timeout: Search stopped: it ran out of time before finding an answer, so this observation may still be reachable. A very long zero distance is the usual cause.
traj_val_range_error: Range must be greater than zero distance
compare_zero_hint: Override zero distance for this entry
compare_zero_invalid: Enter a zero distance from {min} to {max}
compare_zero_no_result: No trajectory with this zero distance — check the zero and the profile.
compare_no_profiles: No profiles available. Create a profile first.
compare_no_entries: Add profiles to compare their trajectories.
ammo_selector_disclaimer: Review and update specifications with manufacturer data
dope_midrange_desc: Mid-range dope chart for rifles from 0 to 500 yd / 500 m. Download and print a pre-filled field reference card for your active profile.
dope_no_profile: No active profile. Go to Profiles to activate one.
dope_no_result: Cannot compute — check profile and conditions.
dope_save_failed: The PDF could not be created or saved. Try again.
dope_precision_desc: A pocket booklet: a profile summary, one page per 100 with elevation, pressure, temperature and wind corrections, and a worksheet to add them up.
dope_precision_req_reticle_fail: needs an MRAD, Mil-Dot or MOA reticle
dope_precision_req_clicks_fail: needs MOA or MRAD on both turrets
dope_precision_req_spin_ok: from barrel twist and bullet length
dope_precision_req_spin_missing: needs barrel twist and bullet length; without them the card prints no spin drift
dope_precision_block_zero: This card needs a profile zeroed at 100 m or 100 yd. Re-zero the rifle and save the profile.
dope_precision_block_reticle: This card needs an MRAD, Mil-Dot or MOA reticle. Set the reticle in the profile.
dope_precision_block_clicks: This card needs turret clicks in MOA or MRAD on both turrets. Set them in the profile.
dope_precision_max_hint: {min} to {max} {unit}. Units follow the zero (m or yd).
dope_precision_summary: Up to {pages} pages: cover, {first} to {last}, worksheet. Fewer if the trajectory ends sooner. Prints 4 per A4 sheet.
dope_precision_summary_blocked: Nothing to print until the profile meets the requirements above.
dope_guide_intro: Each distance page gives every correction for that distance, in clicks, MRAD or MOA as you chose. Add the ones you need on the worksheet, the last page.
dope_guide_elevation_text: What to dial from your 100 m (or 100 yd) zero for the distance of the page. + is up.
dope_guide_extra_text: Target 25, 50 or 75 past the page distance: add these corrections to 1.
dope_guide_pressure_text: Station pressure where you shoot, not the sea-level QNH. Take the nearest column and add its correction. The card is made for 1013 hPa (29.92 inHg).
dope_guide_temperature_text: Air temperature, nearest column, add its correction. The card is made for 15 °C (59 °F).
dope_guide_spin_title: Spin drift and time of flight
dope_guide_spin_text: The bullet drifts with the barrel twist. Dial the printed correction in the printed direction. The flight time is for leading moving targets. Without a twist and bullet length in the profile, the card prints no spin drift.
dope_guide_wind_intro: The card shows one quarter of the wind clock, from XII to III, with a line every 15°: I (30°), II (60°) and III (90°), and between them the half hours, 15°, 45° and 75°. The other quarters hold the same numbers.
dope_guide_wind_figure_label: Example: the 4 m/s ring meets the II line at 11 clicks.
dope_guide_wind_legend_clicks: Correction where a ring meets a direction
dope_guide_wind_caption: 4 m/s from 2 o'clock: follow the 4 ring to the II line, 11 clicks.
dope_guide_wind_side: Wind from the right (between XII and VI): dial right. From the left (between VI and XII): same correction, dial left.
dope_guide_wind_rays: Each line has one number per ring, in order from the centre out. On the two inner rings, the numbers of the 15°, 45° and 75° lines sit just outside their ring, so that they do not overlap.
dope_guide_wind_between: Between two rings, take the middle.
dope_guide_wind_mph: With wind in mph, the rings are 5, 10, 15 and 20 mph. Distances follow the zero, in m or yd, whatever the units of wind, pressure and temperature.
dope_guide_clock_caption: Which line to read for each direction
dope_guide_clock_half: ½ is the half hour: XII½ is half past XII, between XII and I.
dope_guide_ex_conditions: Target 750 m, 900 hPa, +25 °C, wind 4 m/s from 2 o'clock.
dope_guide_ex_note: Example only: these are the numbers of a sample 6.5 Creedmoor card. Use the card made for your own profile.
dope_guide_print_text: The pages are A6. Print at 100 %, not "Fit to page". On A4 paper, choose 4 pages per sheet, then cut. Check the card against your own shots before relying on it.
welcome_title: Know what to dial before you shoot.

welcome_step_rifle_text: A name, the scope, its height, zero distance and click value.
welcome_step_ammo_text: Pick it from the list, or copy the numbers from the box.
welcome_step_velocity_text: From your chronograph, or the box if you have none.
welcome_sample: Try it with a sample profile
welcome_privacy: Stays on this device. No account.
setup_rifle_intro: ZRO needs these to know where your scope points.
setup_field_click_hint: How far one click moves the shot. It is printed on the turret or in the scope manual.
setup_ammo_intro: Pick yours from the list. ZRO fills in the bullet data for you.
setup_ammo_not_listed: Not in the list? Enter the numbers from the box
setup_ammo_missing: Pick an ammunition from the list, or enter the numbers from the box.
setup_velocity_intro: From your chronograph, or the box if you have none.
setup_field_velocity_hint: Speed of the bullet as it leaves the barrel. The box gives it for a test barrel; yours may differ.

import_summary_unnamed: {count} of {total} will be added. The profile in use stays.
import_summary_unnamed_one: 1 of {total} will be added. The profile in use stays.

profile_editor_intro: Rifle, scope, ammunition and zero for this profile. Saved changes apply to every screen.
profile_editor_temp_hint: Correct the velocity for the temperature of the day
profile_editor_spin_hint: Include the sideways drift from the bullet's spin. Needs the twist and bullet length.
profile_editor_ammo_check: Check the numbers against the maker's data. Changing them here only affects this profile.
profile_editor_ammo_or_type: Or enter the numbers from the box below.
ammo_selector_intro: Pick the ammunition for {name}. ZRO fills in bullet weight, diameter, BC, drag model and length.
ammo_selector_intro_unnamed: Pick the ammunition. ZRO fills in bullet weight, diameter, BC, drag model and length.
ammo_selector_fills: These values replace the ammunition fields of {name}. Its muzzle velocity stays as it is: measure it with your rifle.
ammo_selector_fills_unnamed: These values replace the ammunition fields of the profile. Its muzzle velocity stays as it is: measure it with your rifle.
ammo_selector_pick_one: Tap an ammunition in the list to see its numbers.
ammo_selector_count: {profiles} from your profiles, {library} in the library
